name: Facial Muscle Physics
algorithm: Facial Muscle Physics — 픽셀 수준 공간 분석
mechanism:
This method verifies facial muscle physics for deepfake detection:

1. **MuscleGroupActivation매핑**: Key facial muscle groups are tracked via action unit proxy: frontalis (forehead), orbicularis oculi (eyes), zygomaticus major (smile), depressor anguli oris (frown), mentalis (chin). Their activations are mapped per frame based on landmark deformations.

2. **BiomechanicalConstraint검증**: Facial muscles obey physical constraints: (a) muscles can only pull, not push, (b) paired muscles produce predictable opposing forces, (c) muscle force follows the force-velocity relationship. The method checks whether observed landmark deformations are achievable through valid muscle activation patterns.

3. **TissueDeformationPhysics**: When muscles contract, surrounding soft tissue deforms following viscoelastic dynamics — skin stretches with wrinkle formation, subcutaneous tissue displaces causing bulging. The method verifies that tissue deformation patterns are consistent with underlying muscle activation. Deepfakes may produce facial deformations without physically correct tissue response.

4. **Inter-MuscleCoupling**: Anatomically, facial muscles share fascia and tissue connections, creating biomechanical coupling. Contracting the zygomaticus (smile) inevitably affects cheek position and orbicularis oculi. The method checks whether these biomechanical couplings are preserved. AI generators often move facial features independently, ignoring muscle coupling.

5. **DynamicResponseProperties**: Muscles exhibit specific dynamic properties: inertia (can't start/stop instantly), elastic recoil, and fatigue. The method analyzes the dynamic response of facial movements — natural movements show smooth acceleration/deceleration following these properties. Deepfake facial dynamics often violate these constraints, producing movements with unnatural jerk profiles.
parameters:
분석 유형: 픽셀
미디어: 비디오

출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)

accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through facial muscle physics analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
